text:
rachael: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about Console + Optimize + API batching. Need clear partner-facing answers.

maria: Short version: partner canary planned mid-May, GA targeted late June. We'll share acceptance criteria.

kevin: Canary scope: Console instrumentation dashboard (read-only), Optimize suggestions API (no write history), generation+embeddings routes only. Dedicated routing tests in later canary.

sam: Ops note: partner canary traffic goes to Hosted. We'll schedule Dedicated pre-warm for follow-up canary.

rachael: What metrics to show partners during canary?

maria: P50/P95 latency, 5xx rate, tokens/req, and a basic quality regression flag from the eval job.

olivia: Sales wants a short line: "Optimize suggestions visible in Console (read-only) during canary; full interactive panel in GA (June)". Good?

maria: Yes, that'll do. I'll post to #marketing.

kevin: DB migration: tiny, backward compatible. Feature-flag guarded so rollback is trivial.

eng-ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-dashboard:v1 -> staging 2024-05-02T18:00Z.

rachael: Owners: Maria -> partner comms & marketing blurb; Sam -> runbook + dashboard by EOD Friday; Kevin -> migration notes & pre-warm plan. Add follow-ups here.
